bingo.helpStep1Text: The moderator or streamer draws numbers (1–75). They appear automatically in the number board below your card and on your card.
bingo.helpStep2Text: You can click cells on your card to mark them manually. These marks are only visible to you and are saved automatically.
bingo.helpStep3Text:
When you have a complete row, column or diagonal:
• Type "{bingoCmd}" in the Twitch chat
• OR press the "Claim BINGO!"-button on this page

Only then will your win be registered! Case does not matter (Bingo, BINGO, bingo — all work).
bingo.helpStep4Text: Without actively claiming via chat or button, no win is recorded — even if all numbers on your card have been drawn. Be fast, first to claim wins!
bingo.helpStep5Text: The streamer sets the prizes independently. StreamBingo is only the game system and is not responsible for prize payouts or prize design. For questions about prizes, contact the mods or streamer directly.

streamer.cpManualHintTitle: How to set up the reward manually:
streamer.cpManualStep1: Go to twitch.tv → Creator Dashboard → Viewer Rewards → Channel Points → Manage Rewards & Challenges
streamer.cpManualStep5: Save the reward – viewers can now redeem it to receive a Bingo card
streamer.cpSetupSuccess: Channel Point rewards set up successfully!
streamer.cpSettingsRequired: Please save General Settings & set up rewards first
streamer.helpTitle: Streamer Help: How to set up StreamBingo
streamer.helpStep1Text: Share the link to your Bingo game with your viewers. You can find the link on this page and copy it with one click.
streamer.helpStep2Text: Choose a game title, your Twitch channel, and the number of winners. Click "Save settings".
streamer.helpStep3Text:
Choose Automatic (recommended) – StreamBingo will create the rewards on Twitch. Then click "Create / update reward on Twitch".
Alternatively: Choose Manual and create the reward yourself in the Twitch Creator Dashboard.
streamer.helpStep4Text: Click "Create New Bingo". Start the game with the play button. Viewers can now redeem Channel Points to get a card and join.
streamer.helpStep5Text:
Go to the Moderator Dashboard via the "Moderate" button. There you can draw numbers, manage winners, and view chat commands.
Note: The bot connects automatically once it has joined your Twitch channel.
streamer.helpFooter: Need more help? Please contact User "X3S2" on Discord.
streamer.cpTosWarningText: Using Channel Points as entry requirements for giveaways may violate Twitch Community Guidelines. You are solely responsible for compliance with Twitch policies.
streamer.cpTosAccept: I have read the Twitch Community Guidelines and act at my own responsibility when using this feature.
streamer.buycardSubMonthsHint: Note: Exact subscription duration can only be checked via Twitch Chat (!buycard). The website only checks if the user is subscribed at all.

moderator.title: Moderator Dashboard
moderator.noGame: No active game found. Please navigate directly to the game.
moderator.helpTitle: Moderator Help: How to use the Dashboard
moderator.helpStep1Text: Here you see all player cards live, drawn numbers and the current winners list. Cards are sorted by bingo proximity — top cards are closest to bingo.
moderator.helpStep2Text: Enter a number between 1 and 75 and click "Draw Number". The number appears immediately on all player cards. In Twitch chat you can also use the command !zahl+N (e.g. !zahl+42).
moderator.helpStep3Text: If a number was drawn by mistake: enter the same number → click "Remove Number". The number is reset on all cards. In chat: !zahl-N
moderator.helpStep4Text: When a viewer claims bingo (chat or button), they appear automatically in the winners list. Use the X button to remove a winner, e.g. if a mistake was made.
moderator.helpStep5Text: The bot connects automatically when the game is started. If the header shows "Bot not connected", the streamer can manually connect the bot: Streamer Management → Bot Join button next to the running game.
moderator.helpFooter: For further questions, contact the streamer or User "X3S2" on Discord.
moderator.randomDrawHint: Picks a random undrawn number. 10-second cooldown.
moderator.assignCardHint: The user must have logged in to the website at least once.
